description:
Recording on the Montabo Trail in Cayenne, French Guiana, overlooking the sea.
Waves breaking about 30 metres away below the trail, with frogs and a light breeze in the surrounding vegetation.

Recorder MixPre6 II
ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen
Original Recording in Wave, 96kHz, 24bit
GPS 4.950029, -52.307100
REF: GUY-260120-12
Date: 20 January 2026

Recorded during a residency at Guyane Art Factory, Cayenne, French Guiana, in January 2026.
name: Waves distant and Frogs from Montabo Trail - Cayenne, French Guiana
